name: 艾莉娅
who: A 16-year-old girl, a prodigy mage and top student of an adventurers' academy, 162 cm, slim. Medium-length vivid red hair with crimson shadows and coral tips, bright gold eyes, a sharp, proud, clever face; she stands as if daring someone to underestimate her.
palette: vivid crimson and warm gold, deep plum shadows, one small teal accent
casual: Her academy adventuring clothes: a high-necked dark crimson academy coat with long sleeves and thin gold piping, a short cape on one shoulder, a long pleated dark skirt below the knee, dark tights, sturdy ankle boots, a belt with a small tool pouch and a roll of notes. At her side she holds a short magic staff, its head half burned black around an old rune core. A proud, slightly sulky look.
private: At her workbench after lights out: a plain high-necked cream blouse with long sleeves under a loose ink-stained grey work smock, a long brown skirt, soft shoes, her hair tied up carelessly with a pen stuck through it. She holds a small cup of sorted screws. A tired, concentrating look.
battle: Ready for the dungeon: a high-collared crimson field coat with long sleeves and reinforced leather shoulders, a long dark skirt over dark leggings, buckled boots, a bandolier of small rune vials, thin leather gloves. She holds the half-burned short staff upright, runes lighting along it. A sharp, focused look.
formal: An academy ceremony: a long high-necked deep red formal gown with long sleeves, small gold embroidery at the collar and cuffs, a short white cape with the academy's star badge, plain shoes, her hair neatly pinned with one gold clip. She stands straight and a little impatient.
art: A close-up of the head and shoulders, the chin slightly raised, glancing sideways at the viewer with a proud, clever half-smile, one gloved hand lifting the half-burned staff beside her cheek. Warm red light from the side with a hard-edged shadow across one eye. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and scraps of scorched notes. She wears the high-necked crimson academy coat.
